subject.statement: Signa Holding GmbH (Immobilienkonzern von René Benko)

summary: Verdict: ADVERSE (99% confidence). Decisive facts: Signa Holding GmbH (legal name SIGNA Holding GmbH, FN 191343m, address Maria-Theresien-Straße 31, 6020 Innsbruck) is controlled by René Benko and operates as Austria's largest privately owned real estate developer. It announced insolvency at end November 2023, converted to bankruptcy liquidation on 11 April 2024, and as of 2026-10-01 the proceedings remain ongoing.

findings.statement: Signa Holding GmbH's legal name is SIGNA Holding GmbH, its Firmenbuch registration number is FN 191343m, and its registered office is Maria-Theresien-Straße 31, 6020 Innsbruck, Austria.
René Benko is the controlling shareholder and chairman of the Advisory Board of Signa Holding GmbH.
Signa Holding GmbH is Austria's largest privately owned real estate company, engaged in real estate development and investment.
Signa Holding GmbH announced insolvency proceedings at the end of November 2023 and applied for self-administration and restructuring in Vienna's Commercial Court.
On 11 April 2024 the Handelsgericht Wien changed the proceedings from a Sanierungsverfahren to a Konkursverfahren (bankruptcy liquidation) for Signa Holding GmbH.

As of 2026-10-01, Signa Holding GmbH's insolvency proceedings remain ongoing, with the insolvency plan requiring a €200 million contribution that has not been fully paid and only a small fraction of claims recognized.
